_doc: Storm Manor (map 2) layout, SPRINT-017 design. Generated by Tools/Level/author_stormmanor.py - do not hand-edit. Metres, UE axes (x east, +y south). Floors 3 m apart on the 2 m kit grid. Validated by validate_stormmanor.py, drawn by render_stormmanor.py. Plan: Docs/Level/StormManor_Plan.md.

_schema.rooms: id, floor, poly (m), kind room|circulation|outdoor|grounds, counts (named room of the brief), wing, risk güvenli|orta|tehlikeli, min_n (Region Gate), surface (footprint material), hides[], evidence[], storeys/void (double-height rooms)
_schema.doors: a, b rooms on the same floor, at = the door centre on their shared wall, width m
_schema.stairs: lower -> upper room, bottom/top points (m), kind grand|service|spiral|ladder|outdoor
_schema.secrets: vent-like passages: a/b rooms and points; never used for connectivity
_schema.chores: SPRINT-016 steps: take | bring | work, at = anchor id (a list = any order), $vars from variants

kit.walls: Quaternius village kit (UnevenBrick outside, Plaster inside)

doors.note: the front door: storm gusts slam it

secrets.how: pull the red book: the shelf turns into the confessional
climb into the dumbwaiter and haul the rope (2 floors)
the portrait swings open; a ladder behind the clock face. Its eyes are a peephole over the meeting table
slide the lid of Pozzo senior's tomb; steps down to a false wine rack
the old well under the greenhouse drains into the cistern; iron rungs
the back of the nursery wardrobe: a crawl between the walls to Pozzo's bedroom

secret_rules.who: everyone once discovered; the Impatient see all of them on their map from the start
secret_rules.discover: a seam glints for 0.35 s during a lightning flash within 4 m (LOS); opening it marks it for everyone who saw it
secret_rules.trace: the panel stays ajar for 20 s and a dust puff hangs at both ends
secret_rules.counter: any player can wedge a passage shut for the rest of the day (4 s, visible wedge); the Locksmith can lock or unlock it

windows.note: the nursery window over the Great Hall

the Impatient can throw a shutter open again (noise cover 25 m, rain wets the floor = footprints)

Çatı yolundan geç, kuleye tırman, feneri doldur: ışık denize uzanır

Kulede şimşekle dolan bir kavanoz al
Kavanozu mahzendeki kıvılcım panosuna tak (koşarsan boşalır)

the orchestrion plays for 40 s: heard 30 m, it masks footsteps and kill sounds in the ballroom

Koliyi giriş holündeki G. köşesine taşı (tek başına yavaş, iki kişiyle hızlı)

the taper blows out on the cliff path if you sprint; the graveyard glows for the night

chokepoints.name_tr: Uşak Koridoru (44 m, 4 m geniş, ortası karanlık)

meeting.note: the long table; the empty chair at its head is Godot's

lightning.seeded: FKGRng at dawn; the day's storm strength (1-3) is announced at dawn
lightning.effect: rooms with exterior windows and the outdoors get KG_SIGHT_DAY for the flash (unlit rooms: 5 m -> 30 m)

outage.who: Impatient (sabotage verb at the spark board or any lamp junction)
outage.cooldown: once per day, never in the first 90 s of a day
outage.effect: all manor lamps off: sight 5 m except hearths, candles, lightning; the grounds stay lit by lightning only
outage.fix: hold the spark board switch (cellar) and the spark coil (clock room) at the same time for 3 s, or deliver a charged jar (SparkJar chore) to the board
outage.trace: soot on the saboteur's hands for 45 s

storm.rattle: seeded rattle windows bang open (sound 25 m, masks footsteps 6 m around), rain wets the floor under them (footprints 60 s); any player closes one with E (2 s)
storm.gusts: the front door and the French doors slam on gusts (sound 25 m), not deadly
storm.sea: the boathouse slip is washed every 20 s (wet 60 s)
